paras: Madascincus arenicola is an extant species of skink, a lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Madagascar.
M. arenicola is found in the Ampombofofo and Forêt d'Orangea regions of Antsiranana Province, in northern Madagascar.
The preferred habitats of M. arenicola are forest and shrubland at altitudes of 25–28 m (82–92 ft).
